dedupe_keys.name: semantically enriched statewide residential building dataset for lower saxony from the lod2 3d building model

description: This dataset gives a flat, GIS-ready version of every residential building in the German state of Lower Saxony, derived from the official statewide LoD2 3D building model in AdV-CityGML 1.0 published by the state survey office LGLN through OpenGeoData.NI. It was published on Zenodo on 5 August 2025 (version 1.0.0) by Abdulraheem Salaymeh of the University of Applied Sciences and Arts Hildesheim/Holzminden/Göttingen, with README, technical documentation and an attribute dictionary. Nested CityGML geometry is reduced to 2D footprints while keeping building height, roof type, usage class and 3D surface areas as attributes, and the file names indicate a household enrichment; this cuts data volume for statewide analysis on ordinary computers. Coverage: all residential buildings in Lower Saxony. Access: GeoPackage (2.4 GB) and CSV (1.8 GB) on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: roof and wall geometry is not kept, only derived attributes. Simulation uses: statewide exposure, energy and planning analyses in Python, R or QGIS without CityGML tooling. Related records: the Glasgow 3D building dataset and OpenBuildingMap.
